_about: The I-90 cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter. The address (the Phoenix lockbox, whatever the state; uscis.gov/i-90 'Where to File', updated 06/16/2026) and the fee ($465 on paper, $0 for a DHS error or a 14-year-old whose card expires after 16; Form G-1055 10/01/26) come from src/card_renewal.py. The attorney approves this file before volume use.

checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.
I-90: a client under 14. A parent or legal guardian signs for them.
Enclose the filing fee by the enclosed Form G-1450 (a U.S. card) or a Form G-1650 (a U.S. bank account), never a check: the amount in the cover letter. Not when the letter says no fee is due.
